tools.name: list_agent_run_skill_files
tools.title: List Agent Run Skill Files
tools.description: List the files in the platform 'agent-run' skill, the platform's guidance for starting, streaming, and interacting with a durable autonomous agent run via @semoss/sdk, as opposed to a single one-shot LLM() turn (see the room/model skills). Call this when the user asks about RunAgent/runAgent, streaming or polling a run's progress, reconnecting to a run after a page reload, approving/declining a paused tool call (RunMCPTool / decideAgentRunAction / submitAgentToolDecision), or subagents spawned by a run (GetSubagentRuns / getSubagentRuns), and when they name AgentRunSnapshot, AgentRunItem, AgentRunItemEvent, subscribeRunAgent, pollAgentRun, or getAgentRun. Returns each file with its path, name, and description so you can read only what you need; start with SKILL.md. Not for a plain one-shot chat message (see the room skill).

project.title: project
project.description: The agent-run skill (agent-run). Always this value.

tools.name: read_agent_run_skill_file
tools.title: Read Agent Run Skill File
tools.description: Read one file from the platform 'agent-run' skill in full, for writing code that starts or drives a durable autonomous agent run. Pass filePath exactly as list_agent_run_skill_files reports it; SKILL.md is the main guide and covers submitting a run, streaming its progress, reconnecting after a reload, resuming a paused run on a human tool decision, and reading subagents it spawned.

project.title: project
project.description: The agent-run skill (agent-run). Always this value.

filePath.title: filePath
filePath.description: Path of the file to read, relative to the skill folder, as reported by list_agent_run_skill_files. Use 'SKILL.md' for the main guide.
